description: This Java class implements a strategy that handles the FeaturePropertiesModified event within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy class and overrides the applyEvent method to modify a ThingBuilder object based on the event details.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that processes FeaturePropertiesModified events, extending AbstractThingEventStrategy and applying property changes to ThingBuilder instances.

methods.name: FeaturePropertiesModifiedStrategy
methods.description: Constructor for the strategy class, inheriting default behavior.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to handle FeaturePropertiesModified events by setting feature properties on the ThingBuilder.
